en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall stone tower-like monument in a landscaped park. The massive structure has a wide arched entrance at its base, small windows, and a stepped, crenellated top. Young trees and paths lead toward the monument, with open land and trees visible in the background. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the location and the name of the monument in German.
